newsitem.title: UK: London stocks ends mixed after Wall Street rally.
newsitem.headline: London stocks ends mixed after Wall Street rally.

text.p: UK shares ended a nervy session mixed on Tuesday as uncertainty over interest rates was offset by another firm morning session on Wall Street.
The FTSE 100 index recovered from a near 30-point decline to finish the day 1.5 points higher at 4,195.5.

The Dow industrials average, which dropped 40 points at the U.S. start, was up 27 points by the London close with investors expressing relief that U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan had not directly warned of a near-term rate hike. "Greenspan's comments were seen as neutral-- no surprises," one dealer said.
